summary: Siskiyou NF, OR: L-4 ground cab dated 1940 (1941 per weebly); removed 1968 or burned in 2002 Biscuit Fire; county and end date disputed; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Register and firelookout.com say the cab was removed or destroyed in 1968; weebly says it was destroyed in the 2002 Biscuit Fire. No source describes the site today.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register and firelookout.com say Josephine County; a May 1940 newspaper item quoted by weebly says the Agness district of Curry County. The story gives both; facts keep Josephine (matches the record and the FFLOS list).
Register and firelookout.com say built 1940; weebly says the L-4 lookout house was constructed in 1941. The story reports both.
Register and firelookout.com say the cab was removed or destroyed in 1968; weebly says it was destroyed in the 2002 Biscuit Fire. The story reports both and notes that no source explains the gap.

notes_for_editor: The end date is the main conflict: 1968 removal or destruction (register, firelookout.com) versus destruction in the 2002 Biscuit Fire (weebly only). The Biscuit Fire source does not mention this lookout, so the story cites it only for the fire itself. Weebly also lists September 15, 1936 panorama photos at this site, earlier than the 1940 build; the sources do not explain it, so it is left out. No staffing after 1941 and no site description today appear in any source.
